correctness.rationale: For odd q and extension degree m>=1, the explicit 5-coordinate K=F_{q^m} Lie bracket (h,h+2alpha,h+2beta) in its last 3 components is an invertible linear transform of all 2x2 minors of the first three coordinates. Thus commuting triples are K-proportional, so each noncentral abelian F_q-subalgebra is uniquely contained in Z plus one K-projective line (dim_Fq 3m); the projective plane has Q^2+Q+1 members, pairwise intersecting at Z (dim 2m). Count subspaces central or in exactly one maximal noncentral abelian plane to get A_d=[2m d]_q+(Q^2+Q+1)([3m d]_q-[2m d]_q). Ideal condition: containing any (a,b)!=0 forces a noncommuting derived bracket; hence abelian ideals lie in L'. A noncentral element of L' forces Z contained, so ideals are precisely subspaces I<=Z or Z<=I<=L', giving J_d=[2m d]_q+[m d-2m]_q-1_{d=2m}. Includes d=0 and d>3m. Independently enumerated 2,664 and 42,176 literal RREF subspaces of F_3^5/F_5^5, checked bracket closure/ideal property and reproduced A=(1,121,157,13,0,0), J=(1,4,1,1,0,0) and A=(1,781,931,31,0,0), J=(1,6,1,1,0,0). Arbitrary m follows structural proof not finite cases.
